en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He is not from us, the one who does not revere (respect) our elderly and being merciful to our young ones’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever does not consider our elders as dignified and does not show kindness to our people who are yet to grow up, is not from our people.”
